correctness.rationale: For magnetizations s_A,s_B,s_C, same-spin edge energy E=(3m²+s_As_B+s_As_C+s_Bs_C)/2 has minimum m² precisely when two parts are monochrome in opposite colors; no other minima. Every configuration has an allowed nonincreasing purification path by successively fixing each part. Ground states form six Boolean m-cubes glued pairwise at six all-monochrome nonconstant junctions, hence one closed irreducible class of size 6(2^m−1); reverse tie flips imply uniform stationarity and Kac return 2^m−1. For a mixed interior of one cube, |S|=2^m−2 and exactly 2m directed exit edges imply conductance 2/[3(2^m−2)] and TV mixing bound ≥2^(m−1). Independent finite state enumeration verified all energy transitions and ground communication for m=1..4 (8,64,512,4096 states), and 2m crossings. Arbitrary-m claim follows from structure, not enumeration.
